tagline: Track your working time – at home, at the office and on the way in between.
too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
setup_text: Create the first account. It gets admin rights and can invite other people.
invite_text: You have been invited to Pendel. Create your account.
invite_invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired or has already been used.
email_taken: This email address is already in use.
work_model_text: Applies from the chosen date. If your contract changes, add a new model so past days stay correct.
auto_break_min_work: Only deduct from working time (minutes, 0 = always)
legal_break_check: Warn when legal breaks are missing
office_gap_max: Absence from the office counts as break up to … minutes
office_gap_help: Longer absences count as working time (e.g. customer visit). Each absence can be changed afterwards.
adjustments_text: Opening balance, paid-out overtime or other corrections.
valid_from_taken: There already is a model for this date.
last_work_model: The last model cannot be deleted.
vacation_suggest_carry: {n} days left from last year – carry over
absence_over_budget: Note: this leaves {n} days of vacation.
absence_hint: Weekends and holidays are skipped. Existing entries in the range are replaced.
integrations_text: Connected services like Home Assistant sign in with an API token. All tokens are listed here and can be revoked.
zone_hint: Name of the zone in Home Assistant, e.g. home or Work
end_estimated: End estimated – leaving work was not reported
ha_integration_text: With the Pendel integration, Home Assistant records commutes, office time and breaks automatically from your location and provides sensors and buttons.
ha_step_install: Install the “Pendel” integration via HACS (or copy the custom_components/pendel folder) and restart Home Assistant.
ha_step_add: Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → Pendel.
ha_step_login: Enter this address, your e-mail and password – the token is created automatically.
ha_step_zones: Choose the person and the zones for home and office. Done.
other_tools_text: For your own scripts or automations (e.g. Tasker): POST events to /api/events with “Authorization: Bearer <token>”.
chart_balance_sub: Balance at the end of each day
chart_window_sub: First start to last finish per day
chart_commute_sub: Avg. to and from work combined
no_data: No data for this period yet.
tax_sub: Figures for the income tax return, as of {date}.
tax_missing_km: An office has no distance – please enter it under Settings → Places.
tax_disclaimer: No guarantee, not tax advice. Office days = days with office time; home office days = days only at home.
calendar_text: Time off and holidays as a calendar on your phone. The address works only on your home network – use an app that fetches from the phone itself (e.g. ICSx⁵ on Android).
calendar_renew_hint: A new address invalidates the old one.
public_url_help: Address under which Pendel is reachable from outside (e.g. via a Cloudflare tunnel or reverse proxy). Used for invitations, the calendar subscription and the Home Assistant setup. Leave empty if Pendel only runs on your home network.
public_url_invalid: Please enter an address like https://pendel.example.com (without a path).
calendar_text_public: Time off and holidays as a calendar on your phone or in your calendar app. The address contains a secret key that can only read the calendar.
totp_login_hint: Two-factor authentication is on: enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.
invalid_totp: The code is invalid or has already been used.
totp_required: Please enter the code from your authenticator app.
employments_text: Each employment has its own flexitime and vacation account. Ended employments stay available in history, statistics and reports.
employment_start_hint: Days before your first work model have no target, so you can enter your real start date here.
change_job_text: The current employment ends; flexitime and vacation start from zero with the new employer. Your work model is copied and can be adjusted afterwards.
previous_end: Last day at the previous employer
vacation_days_hint: Usually pro rata in the first year; leave empty to set it later.
delete_employment_confirm: Permanently delete “{name}” ({start} – {end}) with all times, absences and adjustments of that period?
employment_open_not_last: Only the last employment may be open-ended.
employment_end_before_start: The end is before the start.
employment_invalid_end: The previous employment must end before the new one starts.
employment_still_active: The current employment cannot be deleted.
totp_off_text: Protect your account with an additional code from an authenticator app (e.g. Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator).
totp_on_text: On – logging in also asks for a code. {n} recovery codes left.
totp_scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app or enter the key manually, then confirm with the code it shows.
totp_confirm_text: Confirm with your password and a current code (or a recovery code).
recovery_codes_text: Keep these codes somewhere safe – they are only shown now. Each one works once if you can't access your app.
sessions_text: Changing your password or turning on two-factor authentication signs out all other devices.
reset_totp_confirm: Turn off two-factor authentication for {name}? All sessions of this account are ended.
region_text: Determines public holidays and when your day starts.
